<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class DocumentController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Retrieve document content for the authenticated user.
     * Supports nested folder paths for organization.
     */
    public function show(Request $request, string $folder, string $filename)
    {
        // Validate that user is authenticated
        $user = $request->user();
        if (!$user) {
            abort(401);
        }

        // Build the document path relative to user's storage directory
        $basePath = storage_path('app/documents/' . $user->id);
        
        // Sanitize: remove null bytes
        $folder = str_replace("\0", '', $folder);
        $filename = str_replace("\0", '', $filename);
        
        // Allow alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, dots, and forward slashes in folder
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.\/]+$/', $folder)) {
            abort(400, 'Invalid folder name');
        }
        
        // Allow alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, dots in filename
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]+$/', $filename)) {
            abort(400, 'Invalid filename');
        }

        // Construct full path
        $fullPath = $basePath . '/' . $folder . '/' . $filename;
        
        // Resolve the real path for existence check
        // Note: realpath returns false if file doesn't exist
        $resolvedPath = realpath($fullPath);
        
        if ($resolvedPath === false) {
            // File doesn't exist at resolved path, try reading directly
            // This handles cases where symlinks haven't been resolved yet
            if (!file_exists($fullPath)) {
                abort(404, 'Document not found');
            }
            $content = file_get_contents($fullPath);
        } else {
            // Verify resolved path is within base directory
            if (!Str::startsWith($resolvedPath, $basePath)) {
                abort(403, 'Access denied');
            }
            $content = file_get_contents($resolvedPath);
        }

        // Determine content type
        $extension = pathinfo($filename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION);
        $contentType = match($extension) {
            'pdf' => 'application/pdf',
            'txt' => 'text/plain',
            'md' => 'text/markdown',
            'json' => 'application/json',
            default => 'application/octet-stream',
        };

        return response($content)->header('Content-Type', $contentType);
    }

    /**
     * List documents in a user's folder
     */
    public function index(Request $request, string $folder = '')
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $basePath = 'documents/' . $user->id;
        
        $folder = str_replace("\0", '', $folder);
        
        if ($folder && !preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-.\/]+$/', $folder)) {
            abort(400, 'Invalid folder name');
        }

        $searchPath = $folder ? $basePath . '/' . $folder : $basePath;
        
        $files = Storage::files($searchPath);
        $directories = Storage::directories($searchPath);

        return response()->json([
            'files' => array_map(fn($f) => basename($f), $files),
            'directories' => array_map(fn($d) => basename($d), $directories),
            'current_path' => $folder ?: '/',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Download a document with audit logging
     */
    public function download(Request $request, string $folder, string $filename)
    {
        $user = $request->user();
        
        // Log access attempt
        \Log::info('Document download', [
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'folder' => $folder,
            'filename' => $filename,
            'ip' => $request->ip(),
        ]);

        $basePath = storage_path('app/documents/' . $user->id);
        $fullPath = $basePath . '/' . $folder . '/' . $filename;

        if (!file_exists($fullPath)) {
            abort(404);
        }

        return response()->download($fullPath, $filename);
    }
}
